summary.text: Matthew Duvall is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 102 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Russell Diamond (R).
A former software developer and high school teacher who now works as a learning technologist, he also ran for the seat in 2020, according to Ballotpedia and his survey response.

paragraphs.text: Duvall was born in Greensburg, Pennsylvania, and earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana Wesleyan University in 2001 and a graduate degree from Drexel University in 2017.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, Duvall described his early career in corporate software development before becoming a high school teacher, and said he has since worked as a learning technologist and instructional designer for schools and social service organizations.
Duvall was the Democratic candidate for District 102 in 2020, when incumbent Russell Diamond (R) defeated him 70.2% to 29.8%.
In that survey he listed raising the minimum wage, strong public education from K-16 to workforce training, and improving the state's technology infrastructure as his priorities.
